title: A jobs report, more big chip earnings, and sticky inflation: What to watch this week
title_zh: 就业报告、更多的大筹码收益和粘性通胀：本周值得关注的内容
summary: The May nonfarm payrolls report and Broadcom earnings will be in focus for investors this week.
summary_zh: 本周投资者将关注五月份非农就业报告和博通财报。

title: Paramount Is Pulling Every Lever to Sell LBO Debt
title_zh: 派拉蒙正在竭尽全力出售杠杆收购债务
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Paramount Skydance Corp. stretched, then stretched, then stretched again in its audacious $110 billion takeover bid for Warner Bros.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——派拉蒙 Skydance Corp. 在以 1100 亿美元收购华纳兄弟的大胆收购中不断扩大、再扩大、再扩大。

title: Tech Stars From the 90s Reborn: Nokia, Dell, Cisco Surge on AI
title_zh: 90 年代科技明星重生：诺基亚、戴尔、思科在人工智能领域崛起
summary: (Bloomberg) -- They were all stars of the dot-com era before fading into the background as the bubble burst and a new generation of tech darlings rose to the forefront. But Dell Technologies Inc., Nokia Oyj and Lenovo Group Ltd.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——他们都是互联网时代的明星，但随着泡沫破裂和新一代科技宠儿崛起，他们逐渐淡出幕后。但戴尔科技公司、诺基亚公司和联想集团有限公司。

title: Wall Street's latest dot-com bubble joke is Knicks-themed: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 华尔街最新的网络泡沫笑话以尼克斯队为主题：每日图表
summary: The Knicks are back in the finals, Michael Burry is talking dot-com bubble, and Wall Street is noticing the 1999 connection.
summary_zh: 尼克斯队重返总决赛，迈克尔·伯里 (Michael Burry) 正在谈论互联网泡沫，而华尔街也注意到了 1999 年的联系。

title: GOP lawmakers' portfolios are migrating to Trump favorites like Intel and bitcoin
title_zh: 共和党议员的投资组合正在转向特朗普最喜欢的产品，如英特尔和比特币
summary: Republican lawmakers' brokerage accounts have undergone a significant shift as GOP members of Congress load up on investments into areas touted by President Trump.
summary_zh: 随着共和党国会议员加大对特朗普总统吹捧的领域的投资，共和党议员的经纪账户发生了重大变化。
